title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Uniform MOF micropores can regulate anion transport and help homogenize lithium-ion flux at a lithium-metal electrode.
explanation: The review attributes restricted TFSI− transport and more uniform lithium-ion flux to the homogeneous micropores of HKUST-1.
scope: MOF hosts used to regulate liquid-electrolyte ion transport in lithium-metal batteries.
conditions: The pore system must distinguish the transport of relevant electrolyte species.
caveats: The demonstrated transport behavior is described for HKUST-1; it is not established for arbitrary MOFs.
